reason: A numbered first-run Czech can is exactly the kind of thing I try and post, so I'd grab one single can at a partner cafe for 59 CZK. I'm not paying 649 for twelve of something that might taste like grass tea before I've had one.
objection: Unsweetened yerba mate sounds bitter, and next to my Monster while studying I'm not sure an unsweetened lemon-grapefruit tea will actually taste good or keep me going.
would_change_my_mind: If the first can actually tastes fresh and not grassy, I'd order the 12-pack before the numbered run sells out; a free tasting can would get me there faster.
